subject: Rolling GPU surge: proposed renewal plan and ops playbook
messages:
From: Sam Reilly <sam.reilly@atlasai.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 22 Apr 2027 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal window and capacity needs

Hi Markus,

We're coming up on our renewal in June (account DL-4821). Usage has been growing faster than expected — our inference volume is up ~2.5x QoQ. Can we discuss upgrading our reserved pool from 8 to 16 GPUs at renewal? Key asks: predictable monthly billing, an activation window that doesn't disrupt production, and a throughput commitment for our high-concurrency jobs.

Do you have a checklist for how Redwood handles a staged activation? Also, can you share any ballpark for the incremental committed charge if we move to 16? Procurement will need numbers to issue an updated PO.

Thanks,
Sam
Sam Reilly
Head of Platform Engineering, AtlasAI
sam.reilly@atlasai.com

From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
To: Sam Reilly <sam.reilly@atlasai.com>
Date: Thu, 22 Apr 2027 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal window and capacity needs

Hi Sam — thanks for the heads up and congrats on the growth. We can absolutely support a move to 16 GPUs at renewal and we usually handle this with a rolling activation to keep customer traffic stable. Attached is a draft order form and a short ops playbook that outlines the stages. High level:

- Proposal: convert current 8-GPU reserved pool to a 16-GPU pool on the renewal date.
- Activation: staggered 4-GPU increments over a 3-week window for canarying.
- SLA/throughput: we can commit a per-pool throughput guarantee and instrument token-level metrics in the Console.
- Billing: standard monthly commit; pro-rated for partial-month activations.

I've attached: Reserved_Pool_OrderForm_AtlasAI_Q3.pdf and an Activation_Timeline.xlsx. If you want, I can loop in our solutions lead to set up a short runbook call next week.

Would a May 10 start for staged activation work for you? That gives us time to finalize SLA language and get the PO.

Best,
Markus Klein
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
markus.klein@redwood.com

Attachments: Reserved_Pool_OrderForm_AtlasAI_Q3.pdf (pdf), Activation_Timeline.xlsx (spreadsheet)

From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 25 Apr 2027 14:22:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Renewal window and capacity needs — need ops + SLA input

Marissa / Dylan — forwarding AtlasAI's ask. They want to double from 8→16 GPUs at renewal and need: predictable billing, a non-disruptive activation, and a throughput commitment. Draft attachments live in Drive: https://drive.redwood.com/atlasai/renewal-playbook.

Notes / questions I want us to answer before I send a formal SLA draft back to Sam:
- Recommended canary plan: start with 4 GPUs for 10 days, validate latency/kv-cache behavior, then add 6 more in 4-GPU increments. Any objections to 10 days for the initial canary?
- Throughput guardrail: propose a soft commitment of X requests/second (we'll replace X with a number based on their profile) and an escalation path if they exceed sustained throughput.
- Billing/proration: confirm how we apply pro-rated charges for mid-month activation and whether we can offer a one-time implementation credit if they sign before May 6.
- Ops playbook: suggest a 2-hour maintenance window each activation step for network routing changes and capacity swaps. That should avoid impacting customer traffic.

Attach the SLA draft once you have suggested edits. I want to close pricing and a PO request by end of next week.

Thanks — MK

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 26 Apr 2027 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Renewal window and capacity needs — need ops + SLA input

Markus — quick thoughts from Pricing + Ops:

- Canary: 7–10 days for the initial 4-GPU canary is fine; shorter increases risk given their traffic spikes. Recommend 10 days.
- Activation increments: 4 → 6 → 6 (i.e., 4 for canary, then two 6-GPU steps) to reduce switching overhead. Total activation window: ~3 weeks.
- Throughput: suggest we offer a guaranteed baseline of 320k tokens/min for the reserved pool with an overflow policy (best-effort routing to non-dedicated capacity if they exceed sustained load). We will instrument alerts in Console and trigger a capacity review if they exceed 120% of baseline for >24 hours.
- Billing: pro-rate each step by days active in the month. We can offer a one-time $5,000 implementation credit if they sign the updated PO by May 6.
- SLA language: add explicit canary rollback criteria (95th latency degradation >30% over baseline or increase in 5xx rate).

I've updated Throughput_Guarantee_SLA_Draft.docx and attached Activation_Timeline.xlsx with the proposed schedule. If approved, we can include these as addenda to the order form.

— Marissa
Sr. Product Ops, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com

Attachments: Throughput_Guarantee_SLA_Draft.docx, Activation_Timeline.xlsx

From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
To: Sam Reilly <sam.reilly@atlasai.com>, AtlasAI Procurement <procurement@atlasai.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 30 Apr 2027 16:40:00 -0700
Subject: Final: AtlasAI renewal — 8→16 GPU conversion, schedule & next steps (DL-4821)

Sam — thanks for the discussion. AtlasAI's renewal conversion is approved on our side. Summary of the agreed plan:

- Scope: convert AtlasAI reserved pool from 8 → 16 GPUs effective on their renewal date.
- Activation schedule (staged):
  • Phase 1 (canary): +4 GPUs (total 12) active May 10–May 19 (10 days)
  • Phase 2: +6 GPUs (total 18) on May 20–May 24 (finalize to 16 active capacity; note: we provision in two steps to reduce risk)
  • Final steady-state: 16 GPUs billed as monthly commit starting May 25 (prorated for May).
- Throughput SLA: baseline 320k tokens/min for the reserved pool. Overflow handling: best-effort routing to hosted capacity when sustained >120% for >24 hours; capacity review triggered automatically.
- Billing: updated monthly commit reflected on Revised Order Form (attached). Pro-rated charges apply per activation day. One-time implementation credit: $5,000 (if PO is signed by 2027-05-06).
- Attachments: Reserved_Pool_OrderForm_AtlasAI_Q3.pdf, Throughput_Guarantee_SLA_Draft.docx, Activation_Timeline.xlsx

Next steps for AtlasAI procurement:
1) Review attached Revised Order Form and updated SLA.
2) If acceptable, send PO referencing DL-4821 and noting the May 10 activation window.
3) We'll schedule a kickoff call (solutions + ops) the week of May 3 to finalize routing and rollback playbooks.

If procurement needs alternate terms, loop me in and we can escalate. Otherwise, I'll treat this as confirmed and ask Ops to provision the first batch on May 10.

Best regards,
Markus Klein
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
markus.klein@redwood.com

Attachments: Reserved_Pool_OrderForm_AtlasAI_Q3.pdf, Throughput_Guarantee_SLA_Draft.docx, Activation_Timeline.xlsx
